name: Milfylicious
source:
Great Uncle Albert has passed away leaving our hero as the sole inheritor of his estate. Along with vast wealth and holdings, comes a solemn purpose, working on behalf of mankind in search of clean, renewable energy.

The massive estate is populated with a dozen beautiful older women all dedicated to their new Young Master. Each willing to put her body on the line to make sure his every need, no matter how wicked, is met by capable hands... mouths... and much, much more.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/maximus14]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
阿爾伯特叔公去世了，主角成了他全部財產的唯一繼承人。與鉅額財富和眾多產業一起交到他手裡的，還有一項莊嚴使命：為人類尋找乾淨的再生能源。

這座龐大的莊園裡住著十二名美豔熟女，個個都對新來的少爺盡心盡力。無論他的需求有多邪惡，她們都願意豁出自己的身體，用一雙雙靈巧的手……嘴……以及多得多的部位，滿足他的一切需要。
